a total of 6,854 doses of JYNNEOS were administered in Louisiana
Among Health Hub vaccine recipients, 45.5% were Louisiana residents
Among persons who received vaccine outside the Health Hub, 90.1% were Louisiana residents
Vaccinations at non–Health Hub settings more frequently reached Louisiana residents who identified as racial and ethnic minorities
Patient demographic information was collected at the time of vaccination by the LDH Immunization Program
